reserved: marker surfaces encoded as their tokenizer-reserved entries
split: same marker bytes encoded through ordinary tokenizer pieces
perturbed: reserved marker surface with a small character perturbation
matched: reserved marker surfaces with ordinary-token count matched
plaintext: ordinary role-marker text without template control surfaces
position_matched: reserved markers with the count adjustment placed after the marker
preceding_matched: reserved markers with the count adjustment placed before the marker
character_split: marker surfaces encoded one character at a time
character_matched: character-split markers with ordinary-token count matched
embedding_near: marker positions replaced by nearby ordinary input embeddings
embedding_far: marker positions replaced by distant ordinary input embeddings
embedding_near_matched: near-embedding replacement with ordinary-token count matched
lookalike_matched: marker variants with matched ordinary-token count
lookalike: surface-preserving marker variants encoded as ordinary text
lookalike_count_matched: lookalike surface with ordinary-token count matched
role_matched: role-position payload with ordinary-token count matched
tool_matched: tool-channel payload with ordinary-token count matched
cue_matched: redundant-cue payload with ordinary-token count matched
